claims.citation: New York Herald, 17 July 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Ship Kenilworth (Br), Brown, Hamburg, 51 days, with
mdse and 388 passengers, to Sloman & Edye. Had 1 birth
and 10 deaths on the passage. 15th inst, J Hans, an idiot
passenger, jumped overboard and was drowned.

Ship Kenelworth (of Liverpool), Brown, Hamburg 51 days, with
with mdse. and 388 pass to R. M. Sloman & Edye. Had 1 birth and
10 deaths on the passage. July 15, J. Hans, an idiot passenger, jumped
overboard, and was drowned.

claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 7 July 1866, p. 4, col. 3 (British Newspaper Archive)
